leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: clearly visible, moderately closely spaced, approximately 8–10 pairs per leaf

traits.notes: Leaves are glossy, entire-margined and elliptic with a prominent midrib and lateral veins (visible in multiple images); apical leaves appear in a paired arrangement at the shoot tip (node with two leaves clearly visible); several leaves show round brown spots and a missing margin section (damage visible but cause unclear); seedling has a single slender woody stem without visible cotyledons (only true leaves observed).
